# Glossary

Heading notation for this book: `### term -- §N (kind)`, where N is the chapter number.

```
### example term -- §9 (blockquote)
```

## Defined terms

### rest window -- §2 (blockquote)
**Canonical definition:** The time dough needs between folds.

### even dough -- preface (book term)
**Canonical definition:** Dough that rises at one even speed.

### crumb map -- §1 (definition sentence)
**Canonical definition:** A drawing of the holes inside a cut loaf.

### speed -- rise -- §2 (definition sentence)
**Canonical definition:** How fast the dough grows in volume.

## Usage and drift guards

### timing (word discipline) -- book usage
**Canonical definition:** Used only for when a step happens, never for how long it lasts.
